info.title: ServiceGrid IQ Controlled Pilot API
info.description: Pilot contract accompanying blueprint v2.0. Managed identity and tenant checks are mandatory. No running service is supplied. Ledger, AI, self-service tenant provisioning, branch-restricted authorization and notifications are later scope. Request datetime values must be UTC; cross-field business rules are enforced by domain services. Authentication was refined in ADR 0002 to server-side OIDC sessions with HttpOnly cookies. Browser bearer tokens are not accepted. See phase-2-openapi.json for the implemented authentication subset; business operations here remain planned.
